title: Hold a pawnbroker's licence
what: Carry on a business of lending money on pawned goods only under a licence.

sources.title: Pawnbrokers and Second-hand Dealers Act 1996 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on a business of lending money on the security of pawned goods except in accordance with a licence held by the person
